title: Sony PlayStation 5 Slim Console
description: Experience lightning-fast loading with an ultra-high speed 1TB SSD, deeper immersion with haptic feedback, adaptive triggers, and Tempest 3D AudioTech. Play an extraordinary lineup of next-gen PlayStation games in stunning 4K HDR.

title: Microsoft Xbox Series X Console
description: The fastest, most powerful Xbox ever. Play thousands of titles from four generations of consoles with 12 teraflops of raw graphic processing power, DirectX ray tracing, custom NVMe SSD, and 4K gaming at up to 120 FPS.

title: Nintendo Switch OLED Model - White
description: Featuring a vibrant 7-inch OLED screen with vivid colors and crisp contrast, a wide adjustable tabletop stand, a dock with a wired LAN port, 64 GB of internal storage, and enhanced audio for handheld and tabletop play.

description: Full Windows 11 gaming in the palm of your hand. Powered by the AMD Ryzen Z1 Extreme processor, 16GB LPDDR5 RAM, and a 1080p 120Hz display with FreeSync Premium for seamless AAA gaming on the go.

description: Escape into worlds that feel, look, and sound truly real with 4K HDR visuals, 110-degree field of view, intelligent eye tracking, 3D audio, and intuitive PS VR2 Sense controller feedback.

title: Meta Quest 3 128GB VR & Mixed Reality Headset
description: Transform your home into an exciting new playground where virtual elements blend effortlessly into your physical space with groundbreaking color Passthrough, 4K+ Infinite Display, and Touch Plus controllers.

title: PlayStation 5 DualSense Wireless Controller
description: Discover a deeper, highly immersive gaming experience with innovative haptic feedback, dynamic adaptive triggers, a built-in microphone, and iconic comfortable ergonomic design.

title: Xbox Elite Wireless Controller Series 2
description: Play like a pro with adjustable-tension thumbsticks, wrap-around rubberized grip, shorter hair-trigger locks, customizable components, and up to 40 hours of rechargeable battery life.

title: SteelSeries Arctis Nova Pro Wireless Headset
description: Almighty Audio with Nova Pro Acoustic System, Active Noise Cancellation, infinity power system with dual swappable hot-battery design, and multi-system simultaneous connection.

title: Nintendo Switch Pro Controller
description: Take your game sessions up a notch with motion controls, HD rumble feedback, built-in amiibo functionality, and premium grip texturing for long gaming marathons.

title: Microsoft Xbox Series S - 1TB All-Digital (Carbon Black)
